dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I do hope I'll get to read a story about a rebellious princess. You know, the type who sheds her long, cumbersome skirts, and learns equestrianism, swordplay... perhaps even medicine.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: She'll live freely, take to the field to defeat evil personally, and defend the people and nation by her own hand...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: ...Hmm. You know what? I might just write that story myself.
